snippet.title: AI-Built FPS?! Crimson System Devlog #2 (Godot)
snippet.description:
Finally wired up enemy possession — here’s an in-engine clip. Jump into a monster and open a door from the other side.
💖 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3876620/Crimson_System_VD_Protocol/ — and join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/BV6mrpDCnp

What’s happening here:
• Possession costs health (balance) and isn’t just for combat: use it to access locked/secret areas.
• Enemies & weapons are 2D sprites inside a fully 3D world (Godot).
• Sensory shift: shaders + post-FX for vision, muffled audio while inside the host.
• Toolchain: code scaffold by Gemini Pro; shader FX by GPT-5 Thinking; art: GPT + Photoshop + DaVinci; transition SFX by VEO3
